scope.campaign: Qwen3.8 base OpenCode WebExploitBench v23 full collection
scope.inspection: local sealed plans, local supervisor state, owner locks, launch receipt, and credential-name presence only

defects.finding: The selector accepted whichever exact plan-only rows existed at selection time. It did not require that set to equal the separately reviewed recovery roster, so a changed local state could silently shrink or alter the attached set.

The attach client rejected sandbox creation and resume but passed every other request through. The current supervisor did not score or relaunch, but the boundary would not have failed closed if its provider calls later drifted.

repair.selector: Require the exact reviewed campaign/task set and exact launch-receipt digest, store their count and digest in the private selection receipt, and revalidate the complete local census immediately before attachment.
repair.provider_boundary: Allow only plan-bound sandbox, process, and receipt reads; one fixed bounded receipt-reader fallback for an exact plan receipt; one filesystem snapshot of the exact sandbox; reads of the returned snapshot; and one release of the exact sandbox. Reject every other operation before the provider request.
